view_frame: The drawing uses a TOP (XY) view for the handle's path and an END SECTION view for the profile. The world frame is defined with X as width, Y as depth, and Z as height. The handle path lies in the XY plane, and the section is extruded along the Z axis.

features.placement: The path consists of two straight segments and one 180-degree arc. The straight segments are parallel to the Y-axis. The left segment runs from (X=-23, Y=0) to (X=-23, Y=15). The right segment runs from (X=23, Y=0) to (X=23, Y=15). The arc connects the tops of these segments, centered at (0, 15) with a radius of 20. The section is a 6mm (width) x 8mm (height) rectangle, centered on the path and extruded along the Z-axis.
features.evidence: TOP (XY) view shows the U-shaped path. Dimensions 'Overall width: 46', 'Both straight ends: 15 long', '180° bend', 'Centreline radius R20', 'Inner radius R17', 'Outer radius R23' are explicitly labeled. END SECTION view shows a 6x8 rectangle. Text states 'Same 6 x 8 section throughout', 'Bend and straight ends lie in XY', 'Section remains upright along Z'.

connections: The left straight segment connects tangentially to the left end of the 180-degree arc.
The right straight segment connects tangentially to the right end of the 180-degree arc.
edit_rules: Changing the 'Overall width' (46) must update the X-coordinates of the straight segments and the centerline radius of the arc.
Changing the 'straight ends' length (15) must update the Y-coordinate of the arc's center and the endpoints of the straight segments.
Changing the section width (6) must update the inner and outer radii of the arc while keeping the centerline radius fixed.
Changing the section height (8) must update the Z-extent of the extrusion.
